channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Inclusive Play Events Coming to Cork and Dublin for Children with Additional Needs
item.description: Inclusive Sensory Swap & Play events for children with additional needs are coming to UCC Cork on 29 March and Dublin on 12 April 2026.

item.title: Rental Law Overhaul: New Rules on Rent, Tenancies, and Evictions Take Effect in Cork from 1st March
item.description: Major rental law changes take effect 1st March: new six-year tenancies, 2% rent cap, and stricter eviction rules for Cork landlords and tenants.

item.title: Collision on R585 Crookstown
item.description: Reports of a collision on the R585 Beal na Blath to Crookstown Road. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Breakdown on M8/N8 Southbound
item.description: Reports of a breakdown, southbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway/N8 at M8(S) Off-Slip,Junction 15,M8S. Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 25 February at 18:55.

item.title: Road Closure on N40 Westbound

item.title: Roadworks on N25 Westbound

item.title: Gardaí Appeal for Help Finding Two Missing Girls from Bere Island
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for help locating two missing girls from Bere Island, Co. Cork, missing since 24 February 2026.
